products.title: Where each one stands
products.lede: From a shipped desktop app to platforms that are still on paper. Here is what we are building and how far along each piece really is.

claude-pet.name: Claude Pet
claude-pet.tagline: A desktop pet that watches your Claude usage.
claude-pet.summary: A free companion that roams your screen and shows session, weekly and per-model usage in one compact pill, with reset timers and a startled look when your token burn spikes.
bullets: Server-reported usage through your existing Claude Code sign-in, with a local-log fallback.
Native on macOS (Developer ID signed, Apple-notarized) and Windows 10/11.
Five built-in pets, plus your own with a simple `pet.json` and spritesheet.
claude-pet.imageAlt: Claude Pet: a black cat in a hooded jacket beside a usage pill that reads Session 11%, Weekly 21%.

llmwiki.name: llmwiki_json
llmwiki.tagline: A self-updating knowledge base for your AI.
llmwiki.summary: A JSON-canonical knowledge base after Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern: the model integrates what it learns once and keeps it current, instead of re-assembling raw sources on every question. What is relevant to a prompt is injected into the AI's context automatically.
bullets: A `UserPromptSubmit` hook picks only the blocks relevant to each prompt and injects them into the AI's context.
Built-in 2D and 3D graph view, no Obsidian required.
Deterministic builds: the same input gives byte-identical output, checked by parity tooling.

moshim.name: Moshim
moshim.tagline: Hire talent. Book hosts. Get found.
moshim.summary: An AI platform that turns your material into a personal site, résumé, slide deck and short-form video, and lets hiring teams, producers and agencies search, cast, recruit and propose in one place.

sides.title: For members
sides.text: Personal site, résumé edits by chat, slide deck, vertical shorts (15–60 s)

bullets: An MCP server with {moshimTools} tools, {moshimResources} resources and {moshimPrompts} prompts, so members update their own careers by chatting with an AI assistant.
Korean-language search by role, region, career and open dates.
Every profile is a static page with JSON-LD, `llms.txt` and a sitemap, republished the moment it changes.
moshim.privateNote: Private preview. Ask us for a walkthrough.

k-factory.name: K-Factory Hub
k-factory.short: Plan v2.0 · phases P0 to P5
k-factory.tagline: A manufacturing ecosystem where anyone can turn an idea into a product.
k-factory.summary: A B2B2C platform for Korea that helps aspiring founders and companies find the right factory. The service plan and a six-phase development plan are written. For now it is a plan only: development has not started.
bullets: Start from public data: Korea's registered-factory records, so buyers can search before a single factory signs up.
Sales-led onboarding with an admin CRM, and business verification against national tax records.
Korean by design: KS and KC certification, prime–subcontractor structures, government support matching.
k-factory.meta: Working title · service plan v2.0, Dec 2025
k-factory.stepsNote: Solid outline: the first three phases, about 17 weeks in the plan.
k-factory.privateNote: Planning documents are internal. Ask us for an overview.

instructor.name: Instructor Platform
instructor.short: Service plan v1.0 · dev plan v1.5
instructor.tagline: A student-management platform built for instructors, not for academy owners.
instructor.summary: A SaaS for Korean academy instructors to manage their students and parents with less effort: vocabulary tests, homework, lecture videos and parent reports in one place. The service plan, business plan and development plan are written. It comes right after Moshim.
bullets: One place for everything an instructor does for a student: vocabulary tests, homework, lecture videos and parent reports.
AI drafts the first round of feedback, and the instructor reviews it before anything is sent.
Students join with the instructor's invite code, and parents can optionally join to follow progress.

b.title: Moshim speaks MCP
b.text: Members edit their own careers by chatting with an AI assistant, and hiring teams search and send inquiries from one too. Three permission levels, hashed tokens and rate-limited public inquiries keep it safe.
b.user: Add the Oct 11 marathon MC gig to my careers and publish.
b.assistant: Done. Your page, profile and search index are up to date.
b.caption: Illustrative flow built from Moshim's MCP tools.

c.title: llmwiki_json feeds your AI the right context
c.text: Every prompt triggers a lookup. Only the blocks that match the question are injected, never whole pages, and an error never blocks a prompt.

d.title: Legible to AI by default

about.title: Building in the open where we can
about.text: Brilliant Tiger ([[ko:빛나는 범]]) is a registered business in Korea, started in January 2026. We build AI-native platforms and software, and publish what we can as open source. Every number on this page comes from our public repositories or our own project documents.

nameNote.title: Why [[ko:빛나는 범]]?
nameNote.text: [[ko:범]] is the native Korean word for tiger, and [[ko:빛나는]] means shining. Brilliant Tiger is its English twin.
